summary: Iteration 41 - courtesy invoice manual send (single from invoice detail + bulk from invoices list). Backend: 16/16 pytest pass (single default/override recipient, no-body, invalid email, draft 400, 404, no-email client 400, bulk escludi_inviate true/false with saltate (già inviata / non trasmessa) and errori 'Cliente senza email o PEC in anagrafica', empty ids 422, cross-tenant ids ignored/404, operatore 403 on send+bulk, unauth 401, log entries tipo=cortesia with correct 'to', cortesia-inviate list). Emails with Fattura_N-2026.pdf attachments reached the local SMTP sink. Frontend: detail button visible only for transmitted invoices (hidden on bozza), dialog prefilled with cliente@example.com, edited address sent with success toast 'Fattura di cortesia inviata a ...', invalid email -> error toast 'Indirizzo email non valido' and dialog stays open, empty -> send disabled. List: checkboxes only for transmitted invoices (not the draft), select-all/deselect toggle, select-not-sent excludes already-sent, checkbox click does not navigate, bulk button count correct, massiva dialog escludi checked by default, result Inviate 2 / Saltate 1 (1/2026 già inviata) / Non inviate 1 (4/2026 no email), mail icons refreshed after close, selection cleared.

minor.issue: Invalid 'to' returns 422 (pydantic validator) not 400 as stated in the brief; UI shows the message correctly via errMsg, so functionally fine.

Sends sequentially in the request (PDF build sync in the event loop + one SMTP connection per invoice); with up to 500 ids against a real SMTP the request may exceed the ingress timeout. Consider background job / batching or a lower max.

issues: MailCheck icon 'title' prop is not rendered as tooltip by lucide-react (wrap in span with title or use Tooltip)
Selection is not cleared/pruned when changing status/tipo filters or search, so the bulk count may include invoices no longer visible
cortesia-escludi-checkbox is a native input instead of shadcn Checkbox (minor consistency)

action_items: Optional: return 400 for invalid cortesia email or update docs
Optional: clear bulk selection on filter change; add tooltip for the mail-sent icon
Optional: CortesiaDialog fetches the full /parties list just to read one email - use GET /parties/{id} if available
critical_code_review_comments: cortesia_massiva: courtesy_pdf runs synchronously in the async handler for each invoice; wrap in asyncio.to_thread for large batches
cortesia_inviate returns all ids ever sent for the company (unbounded) - fine now, may grow large
